description: Called before his father was up, prayed the fingers were shillings, and kept the sum unsaid.
name: Cuthbert Burbage

description: Wore both cloaks, and would not say a sum.
name: James Burbage

description: Played the king this book allows, and did not give the crown away.
name: Richard Burbage

description: Refused a price a second time, and went toward home.
name: William Shakespeare
